item: reader copies badge and Related leave out what an outlet repeats on half its pages
summary: Field test 2026-11-14 row 67 (report 7.1): one hbl.fi article showed ~12 unrelated hbl.fi pages as near-identical copies and Related ranked by 17 shared keywords that were all the platform's page text. Read-time only, nothing stored or recomputed (the mass import runs). Each source learns the word 5-shingles on at least half of its 20 most recent distinct pages (after src.ingest.furniture.strip_furniture; pages one by title, or by what is left once a provisional template is removed, count once; a title most of the sample shares groups nothing; under 8 groups learns nothing), which learns a heavy template and a paywall block on part of the pages. The copies badge then decides PER PAIR with exact Jaccard (near_duplicate_clusters gains group_of/group_drop, at most 64 docs): a shingle only one page carries is left out when its own source learned it, one both carry only when both sources learned it. So one outlet's pages are compared without its template, a real copy at another outlet is still found even when its outlet learned that story or a wire footer, and sister sites sharing one template are not copies through it. A pair with an emptied side is never a copy. Related and the badge's candidate ranking leave out keywords on at least half of the source's newest 500 articles (from 10 articles up). Both cached per source 30 min, keyed by store engine. Limit: two updates of a story an outlet learned as its template are no longer copies of each other at that outlet. Briefing and corpus-coordination clusters are unchanged (they pass no groups).
